sections.label: Government securities issuance limit increase
sections.summary: The passage proposes raising the Government securities issuance ceiling by S$200 billion to S$690 billion, expected to last till 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The last increase in the issuance limit was in April 2012, when Parliament approved the increase of the Government's issuance limit from S$320 billion to S$490 billion.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: As at March 2016, the outstanding amount of securities is S$429 billion, and we are on track to fully utilise the current limit by end of 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The outstanding amount of securities is projected to reach S$690 billion by the end of 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: About 84% of the increase is expected to be issued to CPF Board to meet its investment needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The remaining 16% of the increase would be primarily for MAS to increase the issuance of SGS in line with the growth of our financial markets to enhance the efficiency and liquidity of Singapore's debt markets in particular, and the issuance of SSB to individual investors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The increase in issuance limit for Government securities has no impact on the Government's fiscal position.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Under the Protection of Reserves Framework in the Constitution, the Government will continue to have to operate on a balanced Budget and can only spend the reserves accumulated during its term.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: I propose, therefore, that the ceiling for issuing Government securities be raised by S$200 billion, to S$690 billion.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The proposed limit of S$690 billion will apply to the outstanding amount of Government Securities, and is expected to last us five years till 2022.
